stem: A box in the shape of a rectangular prism has a square base with side length \(s\) centimeters. The height of the box is 3 centimeters less than \(s\). The volume of the box is 108 cubic centimeters. What is the value of \(s\)?
solution: Test \(s = 6\): \(36 \cdot 3 = 108\). Factoring gives \((s - 6)(s^{2} + 3s + 18) = 0\), and the quadratic factor has no real roots.
So \(s = 6\). (Graphing \(y = x^{2}(x - 3)\) and \(y = 108\) also shows one intersection, at \(x = 6\).)
verify:
s = symbols('s', real=True)
sol = solve(Eq(s**2*(s - 3), 108), s)
assert sol == [6]
assert [Rational(v) for v in spr_answers] == sol
